meta.name: Always on Call
meta.description: A devoted team of medical professionals navigate personal struggles, political pressure and a risky new hire at an overwhelmed emergency room in Oslo.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Surgeon Sofia faces disciplinary trouble after ignoring rules to perform an off-duty rescue at a busy clinic.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Sofia adjusts to her new clinic assignment, while shift leader Renate distracts herself from personal issues with a workplace crisis.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: An office bingo game creates a difficult test for Sofia, Renate launches a new strategy, and an intern challenges chief doctor Anders.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A paramedic's romantic move goes awry, doctor Leo makes a hard decision outside his job description, and Sofia treats a complex case.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A heavy snowstorm hits Oslo as director Stig learns troubling information about a staff physician and Anders asks Sofia for an off-the-record favor.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Several staff members face major career choices after Stig receives a strict ultimatum and Sofia learns news regarding her suspension.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Sofia and Anders must perform an emergency surgery on a critically injured child, overshadowing the outcome of her suspension hearing.
